sections.fullText: SevaDeep Monthly NGO Review | September 2020 | Current NGO Needs In Pune City

paragraphs: As we approach the end of September, we’d like to summarise our activity and share updates from our work with the numerous NGO’s and Foundations of the country.
During the month of September, we
registered a large number of new NGOs. Today, there are 423 organisations listed on the SevaDeep platform and they could all use your help!
We also recorded over one thousand donations till date since the launch of our initiate and addressed the needs of over three hundred foundations.

These numbers are impressive albeit we cannot forget the thousands of people who could still benefit from your donation of old items, old clothes, toys, furniture, old electrical appliances and dry food items.
Today, we would like to introduce three organisations that could use your help.

The foundation is based in Galandwadi, Pune and is home to many orphans and single parents. The NGO provides a safe home to displaced individuals and children and supports them by providing them education, food, shelter and engaging in extra curricular activities. The NGO has an urgent requirement of clothes, utensils, legumes and toys or games. If you have old items to donate and would like to make a donation to this foundation, click here.

This foundation is based in Hadapsar, Pune and provides a safe and nurturing environment to young children. The NGO structures a wide array of social and educational programs, environmental awareness and sanitation programs and a safe haven for children in need. The foundation is in urgent need of educational supplies for a new school they constructed in a nearby village. For more information, click here.

The foundation is operated by Madhunand Society and currently houses 100 individuals above the age of 65. These displaced individuals have lost their family and the NGO provides them a safe roof over their head. The organisation is in need of three bookshelves for its new library. If you have shelves you can donate, click here.
Be sure to stay tuned to the latest happenings on our Facebook page. Check out the other NGO requirements directly on the platform.
Remember, every blessed human being has a kind side and wants to help the less fortunate ones. SevaDeep is here to help you reach those in need.
